ledger.note: 19 December 1914: Hussein Kamel proclaims himself Sultan of Egypt, a British protectorate. The infobox gives 'Established: 19 December 1914' and 'Status: Protectorate of the United Kingdom'; he 'declared Egypt's independence from the Ottoman Empire', which 'brought to an end the de jure Ottoman sovereignty over Egypt'. The page names no land.

ledger.note: 19 December 1914: Egypt becomes a British protectorate. The infobox of the Sultanate page gives 'Established: 19 December 1914' and 'Status: Protectorate of the United Kingdom'; the lead says the sultanate 'existed from 1914, after the outbreak of World War I, to 1922'. Mirrors the british-africa dossier's vassal_start of December 1914 (counterpart sultanate-of-egypt).

ledger.note: 17 November 1915: the Senussi attack Sollum. 'On the night of 17 November, Senussi fired into the camp at Sollum'; a zawiet at Sidi Barrani was occupied the next night and on 11 February 1916 'Sayyid Ahmed ash-Sharif occupied the oasis at Bahariya'. The page does not list the Sultanate as a belligerent: the war was British and Italian.

region.text: the Western Desert: Sollum and Sidi Barrani on the coast and the oases of Siwa, Bahariya, Farafra, Dakhla and Kharga

ledger.note: February 1917: the campaign ends. Infobox 'November 1915 - February 1917', 'British-Italian victory'; Sidi Barrani was entered on 28 February 1916, Sollum reached on 14 March 1916 and Kharga on 15 April 1916; the modus vivendi of 12 April 1917 left 'Jaghbub ... under Egyptian sovereignty, administered by Idris'.

ledger.note: 28 February 1922: the protectorate ends. 'On 28 February 1922, Britain unilaterally declared Egyptian independence'; four matters stayed 'absolutely reserved to the discretion' of the British government, among them 'the defence of Egypt against all foreign aggressors or interference, direct or indirect', and Allenby 'remained on, until 1925, as British High Commissioner'. Mirrors the british-africa dossier's vassal_end of February 1922.

wars.note: The page does not list the Sultanate of Egypt as a belligerent; Britain declared war on the Ottoman Empire on 5 November 1915 and the Ottoman Empire and Germany courted the Senussi.

notes:
Written by group me-10-h as the predecessor of the Kingdom of Egypt; Cliopatria has no row (the land is inside British Africa to 1921; the british-africa dossier records a vassal_start for sultanate-of-egypt in December 1914 and a vassal_end in February 1922). The Sinai and Palestine campaign (Ottoman attacks on the Suez Canal), the Egyptian revolution of 1919 and the Sudan condominium were not read within the 2-page budget. The pages gave no area, so the outline is the Kingdom's shape of 1922.

Repair round (2026-10-25): the protectorate is now in the ledger as a vassal_start (1914-12) and vassal_end (1922-02) with british-africa as counterpart, mirroring that dossier's events 29 and 37; the Sultanate page (re-read) gives 'Established: 19 December 1914', 'Status: Protectorate of the United Kingdom', and the reserved matters of 1922. The page does not mention 18 December 1914 (the date usually given for the declaration of the protectorate), so 19 December is kept.
